title: Re: Strike at Storeroom 3A
description: Re: Strike at Storeroom 3A — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Wally Wanka

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Destroy 12 Candy Fabricators in Storeroom 3A and return to Wally Wanka in The Embercore Portal.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Wally Wanka

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Embercore Path

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Destroy 12 Candy Fabricators in Storeroom 3A and return to Wally Wanka in The Embercore Portal.

Offer:

The Abba Labbas in Storeroom 3A must have had some back up Candy Fabricators nearby because they already have some back online. Why can't they have a point of failure like every other company? Are they trying to make me look bad or something? I'm a candy maker not some corporate strategy guru, for crying in the mud!

Get back into Storeroom 3A and destroy those blasted Candy Fabricators! If I am going to get the candy factory back then we need to weaken Abaddon's ability to churn out his popular candies! Return to me, Wally Wanka, here in The Embercore Portal when you have destroyed those infernal machines.

Turn-in:

Way to take action, Dungeon Runner. Let me know if you want to do this again.

Objectives:

  • Candy Fabricators

Level range: 42–100
